doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Family photos: sisters, New York and a grandfather who played flute
summary: Billie shows pictures of her sisters Ida and Sadie, De De's mother and a niece; De De says his mother's father was an opera flutist.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
